name: dimfort-vscode
description: Dimensional homogeneity checker for Fortran (LSP client).

commands.title: Toggle Full Unit Trace in Hover

dimfort.executable.description: Path to the `dimfort` executable. Override if the binary isn't on $PATH (e.g. point at a virtualenv: /path/to/.venv/bin/dimfort).

dimfort.trace.server.description: Trace LSP messages between VSCode and the DimFort server (visible in the Output panel).

dimfort.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inline ghost-text units next to each variable reference. Off by default — redundant beside the DimFort side panel and detailed hover.

dimfort.completion.enabled.description: Suggest known unit names when typing inside `@unit{…}`.

dimfort.codeActions.enabled.description: Offer a quick fix that inserts a `!< @unit{}` annotation on variable declarations that lack one.

dimfort.gotoDefinition.enabled.description: Enable Go to Definition on variables and function/subroutine calls.

dimfort.codeLens.enabled.description: Show a CodeLens above each function/subroutine definition with its inferred signature. Off by default — can be visually busy on dense files; turn on with the `DimFort: Toggle Code Lens` command.

dimfort.trace.enabled.description: Master switch: when on (the default), upgrades all three `dimfort.hover.*` surfaces still set to `short` to `detailed`. Set to false (and leave the per-surface settings at `short`) for compact hovers. Toggle with the `DimFort: Toggle Full Unit Trace in Hover` command.

dimfort.hover.functionCalls.description: Hover layout when the cursor is on a function call's callee identifier. `short`: one row per arg pairing formal vs. actual unit. `detailed`: the same plus a sub-tree underneath any computed argument showing how its unit was derived.

dimfort.hover.subroutineCalls.description: Hover layout when the cursor is on a subroutine call's callee identifier. Same options as `dimfort.hover.functionCalls`.

dimfort.hover.expressions.description: Hover layout when the cursor is inside an expression — assignment LHS/RHS, call argument, IF/ELSEIF/WHERE condition, DO loop bound, or SELECT CASE selector. `short`: the bare `name : unit` hover. `detailed`: the full unit-algebra rule-chain tree.

dimfort.maxWorksetSize.description: Maximum number of files included in a single check pipeline. On large workspaces (~2000+ files) the full transitive use-closure can be too deep to compile in memory; when it exceeds this cap, DimFort keeps the active file plus its nearest dependencies in topo order. Restart the language server to apply.

dimfort.externalModules.description: Extra module names treated as external (i.e. not resolved against the workspace; no U007 diagnostic when missing). Extends DimFort's built-in allowlist (Fortran intrinsics, mpi, netcdf, ioipsl, …). Restart the language server to apply.

dimfort.cache.mode.description: Content-hash cache for the workspace check. `read-write` (default): replay and update the cache. `read-only`: replay cached diagnostics but never write. `off`: no caching. On large workspaces (~2000 files), a warm cache drops total check time substantially (LMDZ-scale: ~33 s cold → ~20 s warm). See [DimFort's cache docs](https://github.com/ArrialVictor/DimFort/blob/main/docs/usage.md#content-hash-cache) for invalidation triggers.

dimfort.cache.dir.description: Optional override for the cache directory. Empty (default) means `.dimfort-cache/` under the first workspace folder.

dimfort.panel.enabled.description: Reveal the DimFort side panel (unit-algebra tree + scope declarations) on activation. The panel follows the cursor. Off by default — open it from the DimFort activity-bar icon when you want it; turn this on to have it revealed automatically.

dimfort.panel.debounceMs.description: Debounce (milliseconds) for the side panel's cursor-follow refresh.
